method: Original Arabic patient-facing synthesis. AAPM&R Conditions & Treatments and PM&R KnowledgeNOW define rehabilitation coverage; independent guidelines, systematic reviews, and recent consensus statements verify management and escalation messages.
rights_note: No AAPM&R patient handout, copyrighted table, image, or wording is reproduced or translated. Sources are cited and independently summarized.
